references.text: Eleazar, son of Aaron, is mentioned as a priest who shall perform holy duties
Use of fire pans (מַחְתֹּת) in holy service, especially in connection with incense
Korah's followers took fire pans to carry incense, which led to this event
The 250 men carried fire pans with fire and incense before the Lord
Fire from the Lord consumed the 250 men who were carrying incense
Explains further why the fire pans are holy - they were brought before the face of the Lord
The principle that whatever touches the holy becomes holy (קָדֵשׁ)
Everything that touches the altar shall be holy
